name.en-US: Sermon Against the Pernicious Doctrine of Martin Luther
name.pt-BR: Sermão Contra a Perniciosa Doutrina de Martinho Lutero

description.en-US: Fisher's sermon preached at St Paul's on 12 May 1521, when Luther's books were burned.
description.pt-BR: O sermão de Fisher pregado em São Paulo a 12 de maio de 1521, quando os livros de Lutero foram queimados.

sources.edition: This sermon ... agayn the pernicious doctrin of Martin Luther, EEBO-TCP A00771.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 4 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. John Fisher died in 1535; the edition is of 1521 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
